item_name: Rothco Patriot US Flag T-Shirt - Black
item_short_desc: Prominently present your pride, patriotism, and enthusiasm for the United States of America with this American Flag T-shirt by Rothco.
description: Prominently present your pride, patriotism, and enthusiasm for the United States of America with this American Flag T-shirt by Rothco. The patriotic t-shirt showcases one distressed American flag on the front, and another on the right sleeve. The lightweight cotton-blend on the flag shirt is perfect for casual wear while also being breathable enough to make an ideal workout shirt. Available in sizes small through 3XL.
